description: Duplicate a creative with a new name and optionally a new headline, link or call to action (same media). Creatives have no status, so nothing delivers until you attach one to an ad. Previews unless confirm=true. Two steps: confirm=false returns a preview and an approval_token; to apply, repeat the same arguments with confirm=true and that approval_token.

approval_token.description: The approval_token returned by the preview of this exact request. Required with confirm=true.

confirm.description: false = preview only (nothing sent). true = apply; needs approval_token from the preview.

name: snap_clone_creative
